title: Magnolia Esplanade
description: A broad waltz lets two-beat bass steps drift across its three-beat bars. A falling melody expands into warm sixths and ninths; an E-natural window brightens the middle without abandoning B-flat. The return is quieter, ending on a gently suspended sixth.
technical_note: Maintain the waltz underneath the bass hemiolas. Balance the upper chord tones as a continuous melody and release the pedal before the written rests. The hand shapes remain compact while harmony changes beneath held upper tones.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
